identity.description: DealCloud is Intapp's CRM for private capital, banking and professional services firms. The API docs at api.docs.dealcloud.com are titled 'Dealcloud Developer Documentation - DealCloud API Docs'. The MCP docs footer reads '© 2026 Integration Appliance, Inc.' and the Intapp page calls DealCloud 'Intapp's CRM'.
identity.identity_notes: Confirmed as Intapp DealCloud by api.docs.dealcloud.com and the intapp.com MCP/connector documentation, which names DealCloud as Intapp's CRM. The docs cover REST APIs for DealCloud sites.

auth.oauth_flows: Client Credentials grant (grant_type=client_credentials) posted to {baseUrl}/api/rest/v1/oauth/token; returns a bearer token sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {token}'.
auth.token_refresh: Tokens expire after 900 seconds (15 minutes) and must be refreshed by repeating the client-credentials flow. No refresh token is described.
auth.scopes_notes: Access is governed by the user's group capabilities (Admin > User Management > user group > Capabilities > Site Areas, 'API' enabled), not OAuth scopes. Docs advise least privilege.

access.production_restrictions: Not established. The MCP server additionally requires a 'DealCloud with Celeste' license and a Celeste Member group with MCP Access for end users; this is MCP-specific.

resources: Schema (entry types, fields, site metadata, currencies, users)
Data (cells, rows, history, files, template reports)
read_ops: Schema entry types, fields, currencies, users (read)
api.rate_limits: Per endpoint: /api/rest/v1/oauth/token 300 per minute; /api/rest/v1/management 5 per second; /api/rest/v4/data 5 per second; /api/rest/v4/schema 5 per second; /api/v1/rest/publication 1000 per second. Exceeding returns HTTP 429.
api.limitations: Rate limits are per endpoint (e.g., 5 req/sec on Data, Schema, User Management; 300/min on token). Publications used for change polling rather than push webhooks. Exact coverage per resource not fully enumerated in research. Relationship between the Profile 'API Key' and the client ID/secret used for OAuth is not confirmed.

open_questions: Is the 'API Key' from the user Profile the same credential as the OAuth client ID/secret, or are these separate? The apikeys page mentions only a key; the token page uses client credentials; the client ID/secret wording came only from a third-party search snippet.
Does a trial, sandbox, or non-production site exist for developers? Not established.
Is a paid DealCloud license required for REST API access (not just MCP with Celeste)? Not established.
Does DealCloud offer push webhooks? Only Publications (Topics, Poll, Acknowledge) polling was found.
Community MCP servers for DealCloud: searches surfaced only unrelated repos and aggregators (Pipedream, Unified.to, RoboMQ, StackSync). None verified as a community MCP server for DealCloud.
Partner or sales requirement for the Intapp developer program or for API access: not checked.
